description: The image is a section drawing titled "Diagram 2.11 Wall type 1 – internal concrete floor", the title set in a pale green band above a black-bordered box. Inside the box, the word "SECTION" appears in the lower right corner. The drawing shows a horizontal concrete slab, rendered with a speckled dotted pattern, running across the middle of the box and projecting to the left and right. A vertical wall section, drawn with a cross-hatched diagonal pattern, sits on top of the slab, and a matching cross-hatched wall section sits directly beneath it, the two stacked one above the other and positioned to the left of the centre of the slab. A thin leader line runs from the slab up and to the right, pointing to a block of text that reads: "Concrete slab may be carried through if mass per unit area is at least 385kg/m²". No other dimensions, symbols or labels are present.
